ticket_number_extraction.description: Ticket number appears in the upper-right area after the label 'TICKET'. Format is comma-separated digits (e.g. 2,204,486). Strip commas to get the numeric ticket number.

notes.ticket_number: Printed as comma-formatted integer (e.g. '2,204,486'). Remove commas before storing. Label 'TICKET' precedes the value on the same line in the upper-right quadrant.
notes.material: Material code (e.g. 7006) appears on the same line as DATE/TIME. Full material name (e.g. 'AGG BASE GRADING D (23)') appears on the following line. The closing parenthesis may be cut off by OCR.
notes.customer: Customer ID (e.g. 2995) appears on the first customer line; company name on the next line. Job/project name follows on subsequent lines.
notes.facility: Location number and pit name appear in the upper-right block, e.g. '2 / Kootenai Pit'.
notes.net_tons: Found in the weight table under 'Tons' column on the 'Net' row.
notes.hauler: Hauler number (e.g. 561) and name (e.g. 'Peak Sand & Gravel') appear in the HAULER column.
notes.truck: Truck number follows 'TRUCK:' label on its own line.
notes.qr_sticker: A QR code sticker with abbreviated material category (e.g. 'Agg Base') may appear in the PRICE/AMOUNT column area — treat as supplemental only.
